title.en: Energy Level Diagram of Hydrogen Atom
title.hi: हाइड्रोजन परमाणु का ऊर्जा स्तर आरेख
title.hinglish: Hydrogen Atom ka Energy Level Diagram

description.en: Energy level diagram showing various spectral series (Lyman, Balmer, Paschen, Brackett, Pfund) of the hydrogen atom.
description.hi: हाइड्रोजन परमाणु की विभिन्न स्पेक्ट्रमी श्रेणियों (लाइमन, बामर, पाश्चन, ब्रैकेट, फंड) को दर्शाने वाला ऊर्जा स्तर आरेख।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 500 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Energy Axis -->
  <line x1="50" y1="350" x2="50" y2="30" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" />
  <text x="30" y="20" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#4b5563">E (eV)</text>

  <!-- n=1 (Ground State) -->
  <line x1="50" y1="350" x2="450" y2="350" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
  <text x="460" y="355" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">n=1</text>
  <text x="10" y="355" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">-13.6</text>

  <!-- n=2 -->
  <line x1="50" y1="200" x2="450" y2="200" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="460" y="205" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">n=2</text>
  <text x="15" y="205" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">-3.40</text>

  <!-- n=3 -->
  <line x1="50" y1="120" x2="450" y2="120" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="460" y="125" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">n=3</text>
  <text x="15" y="125" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">-1.51</text>

  <!-- n=4 -->
  <line x1="50" y1="80" x2="450" y2="80" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="460" y="85" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">n=4</text>
  <text x="15" y="85" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">-0.85</text>

  <!-- n=5 -->
  <line x1="50" y1="60" x2="450" y2="60" stroke="#000" stroke-width="0.5" />
  <text x="460" y="65" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">n=5</text>
  <text x="15" y="65" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">-0.54</text>

  <!-- n=infinity -->
  <line x1="50" y1="40" x2="450" y2="40" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="5,5" />
  <text x="460" y="45" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">n=∞</text>
  <text x="20" y="45" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">0.00</text>

  <!-- Lyman Series -->
  <g stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="1.5">
    <line x1="100" y1="200" x2="100" y2="345" />
    <polygon points="100,350 96,342 104,342" fill="#8b5cf6" stroke="none" />
    <line x1="130" y1="120" x2="130" y2="345" />
    <polygon points="130,350 126,342 134,342" fill="#8b5cf6" stroke="none" />
    <line x1="160" y1="80" x2="160" y2="345" />
    <polygon points="160,350 156,342 164,342" fill="#8b5cf6" stroke="none" />
    <line x1="190" y1="40" x2="190" y2="345" />
    <polygon points="190,350 186,342 194,342" fill="#8b5cf6" stroke="none" />
  </g>
  <text x="125" y="370" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#8b5cf6" text-anchor="middle">Lyman</text>

  <!-- Balmer Series -->
  <g stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5">
    <line x1="240" y1="120" x2="240" y2="195" />
    <polygon points="240,200 236,192 244,192" fill="#ef4444" stroke="none" />
    <line x1="270" y1="80" x2="270" y2="195" />
    <polygon points="270,200 266,192 274,192" fill="#ef4444" stroke="none" />
    <line x1="300" y1="40" x2="300" y2="195" />
    <polygon points="300,200 296,192 304,192" fill="#ef4444" stroke="none" />
  </g>
  <text x="270" y="225" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#ef4444" text-anchor="middle">Balmer</text>

  <!-- Paschen Series -->
  <g stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="1.5">
    <line x1="350" y1="80" x2="350" y2="115" />
    <polygon points="350,120 346,112 354,112" fill="#f59e0b" stroke="none" />
    <line x1="375" y1="60" x2="375" y2="115" />
    <polygon points="375,120 371,112 379,112" fill="#f59e0b" stroke="none" />
    <line x1="400" y1="40" x2="400" y2="115" />
    <polygon points="400,120 396,112 404,112" fill="#f59e0b" stroke="none" />
  </g>
  <text x="375" y="145" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#f59e0b" text-anchor="middle">Paschen</text>

</svg>
